  (M : GeneratedFoundations.Operations.SourceSpinCorner.Mat2)
  (F : ↥GeneratedFoundations.Correlation.ComplexGaussianStates.ComplexL2) :
  ((GeneratedFoundations.Operations.SourceSpinCorner.corner hb) M) F =
    (M 0 0 * inner ℂ (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteSource.groundState hb) F +
          M 0 1 * inner ℂ (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteSource.firstState hb) F) •

  (A : GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceHaarYangMillsAction.ColourCore) :
  GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceHaarYangMillsAction.action L z radial A =
    GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGeneratedRadialVariation.sourceRadialPotential z radial +
        1 / 2 *
          ∫ (x : GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.SourceSpinCentre.CentralQuotient),
            ∑ j,
              2 *
                GeneratedFoundations.Physical.SourceGeneratedYangMillsFrameResponse.frameQuadratic

  (hμ : GeneratedFoundations.Probability.HilbertCompositionalAxioms μ)
  (o : GeneratedFoundations.Source.CarrierOrientation.OrientationOnCarrier d) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :

          ENNReal.ofReal (GeneratedFoundations.Correlation.GaussianCorrelation.state b 0 y ^ 2)) ∧

          (μ (b ^ 2 / 2)) =

          ENNReal.ofReal (GeneratedFoundations.Operations.HermiteSource.groundProfile b y ^ 2)

GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.SourcePreExchangeResponse.tensorCoordinates.{u_1, u_2} {E : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2}
  [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module ℂ F] (e : Module.Basis (Fin 4) ℂ E)
  (f : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℂ F) (b : Module.Basis (Fin 4 × Fin 2) ℂ (TensorProduct ℂ E F)) (hb : b = e.tensorProduct f)
  (A : Module.End ℂ E) (h : Module.End ℂ F) :
  (LinearMap.toMatrix b b) (TensorProduct.map A h) =
    Matrix.kroneckerMap (fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2) ((LinearMap.toMatrix e e) A) ((LinearMap.toMatrix f f) h)

  [TopologicalSpace (Bundle.TotalSpace (↥GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.SourceJointResponse.S) E)]
  (e f : Bundle.Trivialization (↥GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.SourceJointResponse.S) Bundle.TotalSpace.proj)
  [Bundle.Trivialization.IsLinear ℂ e] [Bundle.Trivialization.IsLinear ℂ f]
  (he : GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.HermitianFrames.IsHermitianChart e)
  (hf : GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.HermitianFrames.IsHermitianChart f) (x : M) (hx : x ∈ e.baseSet)

      (GeneratedFoundations.Geometry.HermitianFrames.transition e f he hf x hx hy)) :

GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.generatedWindow_neumannBasis {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
  ∃ B,
    (∀
        (f :
          ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.ComplexIntervalL2 (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLeft b)
              (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowRight b))),
        f ∈
            GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumannDomain (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLeft b)
              (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowRight b) ↔
          Summable fun n =>
            GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.neumannEigenvalue (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLengthGenerated b) n ^
                2 *
              ‖inner ℂ (B n) f‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ∀
        (f :
          ↥(GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumannDomain (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLeft b)
              (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowRight b)))
        (n : ℕ),
        inner ℂ (B n) ((GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.complexNeumannOperator ⋯).toFun f) =
          ↑(GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.neumannEigenvalue (GeneratedFoundations.Spectral.windowLengthGenerated b) n) *
            inner ℂ (B n) ↑f
